name: Light Frame Certification
description: Cleared to fly Light-class frames — fast, fragile, and forgiving to learn on.

name: Medium Frame Certification
description: Cleared to fly Medium-class frames once footwork holds up under sustained fire.

name: Heavy Frame Certification
description: Cleared to fly Heavy-class frames — you can take a hit now, so start taking them.

name: Vanguard Specialization
description: Front-row melee doctrine: hit first, hit hardest, and dare the enemy to focus you down.

name: Marksman Specialization
description: Back-row precision doctrine: read the field, take the shot the enemy didn't see coming.

name: Field Tech Specialization
description: Certified to keep a squad's frames running mid-battle instead of just after it.

name: Recon Specialization
description: Certified for forward scouting — reading the map before the map reads you.

name: Wing Lead Specialization
description: Certified to lead a squad as more than a formation slot — morale, tempo, and the hard calls.
